remarks: Luxurious fully furnished penthouse with jaw-dropping water & city views day and night in Stamford's premier waterfront community, Shippan Point. Exclusive building with private elevator, separate entrance, and only two units per floor. Renovated throughout with a stunning kitchen, oversized quartz breakfast bar, and spa-like baths. Balcony overlooks the marina; sunsets, boats, and beach living just minutes away. Close to downtown, dining, shopping, and train. Covered parking available. Annual and short-term lease options available.
